ORGANIZER RECOVERY - v34

Organizer settings now use %USERPROFILE%\.HudWall\Organizer\config.json.
This location is independent of the app-data virtualization of the program that
launched HUD Live. DESKNEST_DATA_DIR still overrides it for testing.

On first launch without a stable profile, HUD Live checks earlier DeskNest
profiles in regular Roaming AppData and installed app containers. It imports the
populated profile, keeps copies of the legacy configs beside the new config,
and translates virtual paths to their actual stored locations when needed.
An existing stable profile is never replaced by this automatic import.

Recovered files stay in their original storage; recovery does not move or delete
them. StoragePath on a recovered frame records its physical fence folder. New
frames use the stable profile's Fences directory. Retain the old storage until
you intentionally relocate its contents; it still holds your recovered files.

Configuration writes are atomic and retain a last-valid .bak. Recovery retains
frame titles, coordinates, pinned items, launcher tabs and sort preferences.

The JARVIS command/ambient panel now occupies measured free space near the
hardware panel and does not obscure the CPU load, frame, week and day strip.
